verses.text_urhobo: Aizik de se Jekọp ọ da nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ, o de ji iji kẹ nẹ, Wọ reyọ aye rẹ ihwo ri Kenan-i.
verses.text_romanized: aizik de se jekop o da ne erhovwo ke o de ji iji ke ne wo reyo aye re ihwo ri kenan i

verses.text_urhobo: Vrẹn, kpo Padanaram kpo uwevwi ri Bẹtuẹl ọsẹ rẹ oni wẹn, ru wọ dia oboyi da reyọ aye ọvo vwẹ usun rẹ emetẹ ri Laban oniọvo rẹ oni wẹn.
verses.text_romanized: vren kpo padanaram kpo uwevwi ri betuel ose re oni wen ru wo dia oboyi da reyo aye ovo vwe usun re emete ri laban oniovo re oni wen

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ ro vwo Ẹgba o bruphihọ kẹ wẹ ro ru we ogbaọmiọvwọ ru wo bu, ru wọ rhe dia egbotu.
verses.text_romanized: oghene ro vwo egba o bruphiho ke we ro ru we ogbaomiovwo ru wo bu ru wo rhe dia egbotu

verses.text_urhobo: Jọ vwẹ ebruphihọ rẹ Ebraham kẹ wẹ kugbe uvwiẹ wẹn ejobi, rere wọ vwọ sa reyọ otọ rẹ ihwo ru wọ kua bru na, re Ọghẹnẹ vwọ kẹ Ebraham na vwọ riuku.
verses.text_romanized: jo vwe ebruphiho re ebraham ke we kugbe uvwie wen ejobi rere wo vwo sa reyo oto re ihwo ru wo kua bru na re oghene vwo ke ebraham na vwo riuku

verses.text_urhobo: Enẹ kọye Aizik ji Jekọp yanran, ọ da yan kpo Padanaram bru Laban, rẹ ọmọ ri Bẹtuẹl ohwo ri Aram, rẹ oniọvo ri Rebeka, rẹ oni ri Jekọp kugbe Isọ.
verses.text_romanized: ene koye aizik ji jekop yanran o da yan kpo padanaram bru laban re omo ri betuel ohwo ri aram re oniovo ri rebeka re oni ri jekop kugbe iso

verses.text_urhobo: Asakiephana Isọ da mrẹ nẹ Aizik nẹ ẹrhovwo ki Jekọp nure o de jo kpo Padanaram ra reyọ aye vwẹ oboyi, kọye rọ vwọ nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ na o de ji iji kẹ nẹ, Wọ rọvwọ aye ri Kenan rẹ.
verses.text_romanized: asakiephana iso da mre ne aizik ne erhovwo ki jekop nure o de jo kpo padanaram ra reyo aye vwe oboyi koye ro vwo ne erhovwo ke na o de ji iji ke ne wo rovwo aye ri kenan re

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp de nyo ota rẹ ọsẹ rọye kugbe oni rọye ọ da yanran kpo Padanaram.
verses.text_romanized: jekop de nyo ota re ose roye kugbe oni roye o da yanran kpo padanaram

verses.text_urhobo: Rẹ Isọ vwọ mrẹ nẹ aye ri Kenan je Aizik rẹ ọsẹ rọye-e,
verses.text_romanized: re iso vwo mre ne aye ri kenan je aizik re ose roye e

verses.text_urhobo: Isọ da yanran bru Ishmael ra reyọ aye, vwọ ba eya ro vwori jovwo, Mahalat ọmọtẹ rẹ Ishmael ọmọ rẹ Ebraham, rẹ oniọvo ri Ne-baiot.
verses.text_romanized: iso da yanran bru ishmael ra reyo aye vwo ba eya ro vwori jovwo mahalat omote re ishmael omo re ebraham re oniovo ri ne baiot

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp da yan ni Bẹẹrsheba, o de hirhe aro ku Haran.
verses.text_romanized: jekop da yan ni beersheba o de hirhe aro ku haran

verses.text_urhobo: O de rhi te oghẹre asan ọvo, o de wo phihọ Etiyin, kidie ọnre na shẹre. Rọ vwọ reyọ ubioragha ọvo vwẹ asan na, ọ da vwọ cha uyovwi ro ki shevwerhẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o de rhi te oghere asan ovo o de wo phiho etiyin kidie onre na shere ro vwo reyo ubioragha ovo vwe asan na o da vwo cha uyovwi ro ki shevwerhe

verses.text_urhobo: O da vwerhẹ evwerhẹ mrẹ ugbaghala ro nẹ otọ re te odjuvwu, o vwo ni emakashe rẹ Ọghẹnẹ ki yere kpotọ kpenu vwọ.
verses.text_romanized: o da vwerhe evwerhe mre ugbaghala ro ne oto re te odjuvwu o vwo ni emakashe re oghene ki yere kpoto kpenu vwo

verses.text_urhobo: O vwo ni, Ọrovwohwo de mudia obenu rọye ọ da ta, Mẹvwẹ Ọrovwohwo na, Ọghẹnẹ rẹ Ebraham na rẹ ọsẹ wẹn kugbe Ọghẹnẹ rẹ Aizik, otọ ru wo shevwerhẹ phihọ na Me vwọ kẹ wẹ kugbe uvwiẹ wẹn ejobi,
verses.text_romanized: o vwo ni orovwohwo de mudia obenu roye o da ta mevwe orovwohwo na oghene re ebraham na re ose wen kugbe oghene re aizik oto ru wo shevwerhe phiho na me vwo ke we kugbe uvwie wen ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: uvwiẹ wẹn ko che bu kiri ibiekpẹn rẹ otọ na, ku wọ hrabọ kpo obọrhe vẹ obọhwẹre kpo obaro vẹ obuko; oma wẹn vẹ oma rẹ uvwiẹ wẹn ọye uvwiẹ rẹ akpọ na ejobi de vwo ebruphihọ kẹ oma rayen.
verses.text_romanized: uvwie wen ko che bu kiri ibiekpen re oto na ku wo hrabo kpo oborhe ve obohwere kpo obaro ve obuko oma wen ve oma re uvwie wen oye uvwie re akpo na ejobi de vwo ebruphiho ke oma rayen

verses.text_urhobo: Nighe, Me vẹ owẹ herọ ke Me sẹro wẹ vwi kasan kasan wọ rare ejobi, ke Me vwẹ owẹ rhe otọ nana, kidie Me sa yan ju we vwo-o bẹsiẹ mi vwo ru eta nana re Me ta kẹ wẹ na ejobi gba.
verses.text_romanized: nighe me ve owe hero ke me sero we vwi kasan kasan wo rare ejobi ke me vwe owe rhe oto nana kidie me sa yan ju we vwo o besie mi vwo ru eta nana re me ta ke we na ejobi gba

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Jekọp de gbunie rhọvwọ nẹ ovwerhẹ rhe ọ da ta, Omuẹro nẹ Ọrovwohwo etinẹ na, ye Me gbe riẹ-ẹn.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin jekop de gbunie rhovwo ne ovwerhe rhe o da ta omuero ne orovwohwo etine na ye me gbe rie en

verses.text_urhobo: Oshọ de muo, ọ da ta, Mavọ etinẹ na mu udidi te; Etinẹ na dia asan ọfa-a da yẹ uwevwi rẹ Ọghẹnẹ, Ọnana kẹ anurhoro rẹ odjuvwu.
verses.text_romanized: osho de muo o da ta mavo etine na mu udidi te etine na dia asan ofa a da ye uwevwi re oghene onana ke anurhoro re odjuvwu

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Jekọp de vrẹn vwẹ irhiọke ride, ọ da reyọ ubioragha na rọ vwọ cha uyovwi jovwo na vwo viotọ o de ku evwri ku enu rọye.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin jekop de vren vwe irhioke ride o da reyo ubioragha na ro vwo cha uyovwi jovwo na vwo vioto o de ku evwri ku enu roye

verses.text_urhobo: O de se odẹ rẹ asan na Bẹtẹl, ẹkẹvuọvo odẹ rẹ orere na vẹrhe Luz e sere.
verses.text_romanized: o de se ode re asan na betel ekevuovo ode re orere na verhe luz e sere

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Jekọp de vẹ ive tanẹ, O da dianẹ Ọghẹnẹ vẹ ovwẹ da dia, rọ da sẹro mẹ vwẹ idjerhe re Me cha wan na, rọ da kẹ vwẹ emuọre kugbe amwa vwo rhuo,
verses.text_romanized: etiyin jekop de ve ive tane o da diane oghene ve ovwe da dia ro da sero me vwe idjerhe re me cha wan na ro da ke vwe emuore kugbe amwa vwo rhuo

verses.text_urhobo: ri mi de rhivwi te uwevwi rẹ ọsẹ mẹ egberhẹnẹdẹ, Ọrovwohwo kọ dia Ọghẹnẹ mẹ,
verses.text_romanized: ri mi de rhivwi te uwevwi re ose me egberhenede orovwohwo ko dia oghene me

verses.text_urhobo: ubioragha nana, ri mi vwo vi na, kọ dia uwevwi rẹ Ọghẹnẹ, kemu kemu ejobi ru wọ vwọ kẹ vwẹ ke Me reyọ ẹkihwe vwọ kẹ wẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ubioragha nana ri mi vwo vi na ko dia uwevwi re oghene kemu kemu ejobi ru wo vwo ke vwe ke me reyo ekihwe vwo ke we
